en: I'd love to try the special lunch menu at <Color:8>Pronto<Color:Default>, Uncle Kaz! I hear it's super good!
I'm in the mood for barbecue at <Color:8>Kanrai<Color:Default>. C'mon, let's go, Uncle Kaz!
I've had enough walking, Uncle Kaz. Let's grab a bite to eat at <Color:8>Smile Burger<Color:Default>!
My feet are sore, Uncle Kaz. Let's go and get something at <Color:8>Café Alps<Color:Default>!
I feel like going to an M Store and buying a <Color:8>Tuna Onigiri<Color:Default>, Uncle Kaz. Think you can make that happen? Please?
Hey, Uncle Kaz! I'd like to see the <Color:8>TV tower<Color:Default> up closer!
Hey, Uncle Kaz! I heard there's a <Color:8>Ferris wheel<Color:Default> in Kineicho! Let's go take a look!
Let's take some <Color:8>PrintCircle<Color:Default> photos together to commemorate our trip to Kineicho, Uncle Kaz!
I hear they have <Color:8>Taiko No Tatsujin<Color:Default>  at Club SEGA, Uncle Kaz! Let's go see if the rumors are true!
I feel like going to <Color:8>Karaokekan<Color:Default>, Uncle Kaz! I'll give you your very own concert, hehe.
They say <Color:8>First Shot<Color:Default> has a pool table, Uncle Kaz. I'd love to watch you play.
We came all this way to Kineicho! We can't leave without stopping by <Color:8>Yamamotoya Honten<Color:Default>, Uncle Kaz!
While we're in Kineicho, it'd be nice to go to <Color:8>Sekai no Yamachan<Color:Default>, Uncle Kaz!
I need a break from walking, Uncle Kaz! Let's find a <Color:8>drugstore<Color:Default> and buy something to drink.
I'm getting a little hungry, Uncle Kaz! We should go buy something at an <Color:8>M Store<Color:Default>.
Let's go to <Color:8>Club SEGA<Color:Default> and play some games, Uncle Kaz!
The view from <Color:8>Iwao Bridge<Color:Default> is fantastic, Uncle Kaz! We should go see for ourselves!
Let's take some <Color:8>PrintCircle<Color:Default> photos together to commemorate you coming to Sotenbori, Uncle Kaz!
Let's go to <Color:8>Yokobori Golf Center<Color:Default> to blow off some steam, Uncle Kaz!
<Color:8>Sotenbori's Ganko Sushi <Color:Default>tastes amazing, Uncle Kaz! You have to try it. Let's go, c'mon!
I heard that <Color:8>Kushikatsu Daruma<Color:Default> in Sotenbori is really good. We should go give it a try!
Fugu cuisine at <Color:8>Zuboraya<Color:Default> is one of Sotenbori's most well-known dishes. We should go try it out!
I'd really like to try <Color:8>Tsuruhashi Fugetsu<Color:Default>'s  okonomiyaki, Uncle Kaz!
Have you had crab before, Uncle Kaz? I'd love to go to <Color:8>Kani Douraku<Color:Default> and try it again.
I heard there are big snow sculptures in <Color:8>Main Street Park<Color:Default>, Uncle Kaz! I wish I could see them... Maybe you'll take me! Sound good?
We should take some <Color:8>PrintCircle<Color:Default> photos as a souvenir of our trip to Tsukimino!
I feel like doing some <Color:8>bowling<Color:Default>, Uncle Kaz! C'mon, let's go!
I heard there's a pool table at a place called <Color:8>Ambitious<Color:Default>. Let's go and check it out!
I'm getting hungry, Uncle Kaz! I'd love a bite to eat from <Color:8>Gyoza King<Color:Default>.
<Color:8>Matsuo Lamb Barbeque<Color:Default> is really famous in Tsukimino, right? Let's go try it!
Let's go to <Color:8>Sushi Zanmai<Color:Default>, Uncle Kaz! Their fish is always so fresh and tasty.
I've never had curry at <Color:8>Miyoshino<Color:Default> before. I really want to try it!
I've worked up a big appetite, Uncle Kaz. Let's get a snack at <Color:8>Seicomart<Color:Default>.
All this walking is making me thirsty, Uncle Kaz. Let's get something to drink at <Color:8>Seicomart<Color:Default>.
Hey, Uncle Kaz! Do you know that <Color:8>ramen stand<Color:Default> that opens in the evening? I wanna go see it!

<Color:8>Ose Bridge<Color:Default> is famous, isn't it, Uncle Kaz?
I'd like to go see it.
We should take some <Color:8>PrintCircle<Color:Default> photos together to commemorate coming to Nagasugai!
Let's go to <Color:8>Club SEGA<Color:Default>, Uncle Kaz!
Hey, Uncle Kaz, can we stop by <Color:8>Bee<Color:Default>? I kinda want to see what it's like inside... That's okay, right?
Hey, Uncle Kaz, did you know that <Color:8>Fukuya<Color:Default>'s mentaiko is one of Nagasugai's specialties? Let's go take a look!
Hey, Uncle Kaz, can we stop by <Color:8>Don Quijote<Color:Default>? I wanna see if the Nagasugai store is any different than the one back home.
I've heard that the motsunabe at <Color:8>Motsunabe Kaede<Color:Default> is really good. I mean, it's in the name, after all. Can we go try some?
Boy, all this walking making me hungry, Uncle Kaz. Can we grab a bite at <Color:8>Hanamidori<Color:Default>?
Are you hungry, Uncle Kaz? I kind of am. We should stop by the local <Color:8>M Store<Color:Default> and get a snack.
Let's head back to New Serena.
Why, if it isn't my little country bumpkin.
I almost forgot. This is for you. It might help you in the Princess League.
It's a quick-change costume. It's an old, special design of mine. I can't bear to see it go to waste, so you can have it.
Quick-change is all about timing, my dear. When you think the time is just right, change into this and blow the audience away!
Yes, I will! Thank you so much!
Don't mention it. Good luck, my little bumpkin.
What's wrong, bumpkin? Someone put a bee under your bonnet? I don't have anything else to teach you, so...
No, it's not that. Today I wanted to thank you for all you've done.
Thank me? Don't be silly! I can tell how much you appreciate my help, and that's more than thanks enough.
Sorry, but I won't be able to live with myself until I've done this. Besides, I think you're going to like this.
Just give me a minute to get ready!
Why, bumpkin, that costume...
All I can offer you is a song, so today I'm going to sing just for you in this costume.
I'm going to sing my heart out for your friend who never got a chance to wear this.
Bumpkin...
I'm going to put everything I've learned from you into this performance, Yoko-san!
I already said there's nothing I want. I'd rather you use the time to polish your skills.
(This isn't working. Maybe I'll ask Momiyama-san what Yoko-san likes. He should be in front of his place near the south end of Bishamon Bridge.)
Oh, hello, bumpkin. What can I do for you?
Nothing really. I was just passing by.
I am not here to keep your boredom at bay. You have some nerve, little lady.
I wanted to thank you for all you've done.
A bumpkin like you wants to thank me? Are you kidding? You have a long way to go before you'll be worthy of such an honor.
But, I wanted to do something for you, Yoko-san. Isn't there something you want?
Nope. Nothing. And I don't want you spending any more of your energy on this! I'd rather you use the time to polish your skills.
(It doesn't look like she's going to tell me what she wants. I wonder what would make her happy.)
(I know! Maybe Yoko's friend Momiyama-san knows what she likes.)
(If I remember correctly, Momiyama-san should be in front of his shop over near the south end of Bishamon Bridge. It's worth a try.)
You're absolutely glowing. Nice work.
I was really nervous at first, but I think it went really well.
Did you learn anything by singing unannounced in front of people who didn't know who you are?
I realized that all I've gone through has been really important in making me who I am.
But I also learned how hard it is to attract new fans.
True. And yet you managed to do just that.
Up till now, your performances have been staged to present you in the best light as a pop idol.
But simply stepping onto a stage that's been prepared for you isn't enough.
Wherever you are, that's your stage. Wherever you stand, I want you to place yourself in the limelight.
I understand.
You can now use <Color:7>Idol Heat<Color:Default> in concert battles more often.
See Upgrades in the Pause Menu for more information.
Well, that's it. I've taught you all the secrets of true beauty now.
Huh? Is that everything?
That's right. I have nothing more to teach you. It's up to you to pursue your own unique form of beauty from now on.
I will! Thank you so much!
Don't mention it. Besides, I did this for me just as much as I did it for you.
That's right. As I mentioned before, you remind me of someone I was unable to help, and that made me want to take you under my wing.
By helping you, I felt like I was helping that child from so long ago. And that took just a little bit of weight off my shoulders.
I'm sorry. I make it sound like I've been using you.
No, it's okay. But I'd like to hear more about that person you mentioned.
We were friends who shared the same dream. I was much younger back then. We were about the same age, in fact.
We were both just getting started, and we promised each other we'd make it to the top together someday.
It was tough going at first, but we sure had fun. But after I was hired to work with a big-name idol, everything changed.
I couldn't pass up such a great chance. I started getting lots of work while my friend faded into obscurity.
I really wish I could have used my newfound success to pull both of us up.
But back then, I was too busy with my own career to worry about others. I ended up forgetting the promise that we made.
I was so engrossed in my work, I didn't even notice when my friend quit the business.
That's so sad...
I've regretted it ever since. How could I forget my friend like that? Why didn't I try to help?
It snowballed into full-blown neurosis until I started to hate being a stylist.
In the end, I left my career and everything I had worked for behind.
You know that costume I gave you, bumpkin? I originally made it for my friend.
I could never bring myself to get rid of it, but I'm glad you were able to wear it. Now I can end my stylist career without a heavy heart.
Yoko-san...
It's been a pleasure working with you, dear, but I believe my work is done here. Maybe it's time I moved on.
Move on? Are you going somewhere, Yoko-san?
Why wouldn't I? It's not like I'm from here. Anyway, I should probably start packing up and whatnot.
(Yoko-san's helped me so much. I really wish there was something I could do for her before she leaves.)
Your Climax Heat Gauge went up.
Your Climax Heat Gauge rose to the maximum level.
You can now use <Color:7>Climax Heat<Color:Default> in Princess League concert battles.
Oh, did you forget what you're supposed to be doing? Okay, here's a reminder...

Go see if you've become any more appealing. Not as Haruka Sawamura the idol, but as plain old Haruka. To do that, you need to perform as yourself without all the extra gimmicks. The parking lot in West Shofukucho would be a great place to give it a try.
Remember what you're supposed to do this time!
Why, bumpkin. Are you here to learn the secrets of true beauty?
Ooh, I like your enthusiasm. Let's get right to it, shall we?
Well? Has your way of looking at things changed after all you've been through?
I've learned about a lot of things I'd never really thought about before.
And I think maybe I've become a little more appealing as a woman.
Well, well. Confident, aren't we?
Shall we put that to the test? Then we'll see what you can really do.
How do I do that?
I want you to go here and sing but dressed just as you are now. Then come tell me how you felt.
No makeup either?
That's right. Otherwise, it's not really a test.
Okay, I'll give it a try.
(Yoko-san wants me to perform at the parking lot in West Shofukucho? It's in front of Komian. Maybe I'll go have a look.)
Yoko-san, you never mentioned anything about buying shampoo and treatment!
Oh, so you did buy it. Thank you, bumpkin.
Thank you for what?
Don't tell me you didn't notice. It's right on the label, see?
What's on the label...? Oh!
This is your own brand!?
Bingo. These are my own special shampoo and treatment I developed with my years of experience working with hair.
It keeps your hair shiny and luxurious... and my wallet flush with cash. Everybody wins!
Oh, and how did you like that hairstylist I recommended? Rather studly, right?
(That guy with the suit and afro? Now that was a surprise!)
Er, I mean... Yeah, he was great. I could see how you two would get along just fine.
I know, right? But hands off, bumpkin. He's all mine.
